title: Low-probability systems.
officialText:
Double-indirect open-spray systems, indirect closed systems and indirect-vented closed
systems shall be classified as low-probability systems, provided that all refrigerant-containing piping and fittings are isolated
when the quantities in Table 1103.1 are exceeded.
